title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
Job Description – Senior Security Engineer

Company: KoinBX – India's Most Trusted Crypto Exchange

Location: Madurai, Tamil Nadu / Bengaluru, Karnataka

Experience: 5+ Years

Work Mode: Work From Office (WFO)

Job Type: Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer to protect our company's website, applications, servers and cryptocurrency platform from hackers and cyberattacks.

Roles & Responsibilities

Protect company websites, applications, and servers from cyber threats.

Identify and fix security issues.

Perform security testing and vulnerability assessments.

Manage AWS Cloud, network and infrastructure security.

Ensure API and application security.

Protect cryptocurrency wallets and blockchain systems.

Monitor suspicious activities and prevent security attacks.

Handle security incidents and take immediate action.

Work with developers and IT teams to improve security.

Maintain security policies and compliance standards.

Required Skills

Minimum 5+ years of experience in Cybersecurity or Information Security.

Strong knowledge of Application Security and API Security.

Experience with AWS Cloud Security.

Knowledge of Network and Server Security.

Experience in Penetration Testing and Vulnerability Assessment.

Knowledge of OWASP Top 10.

Basic programming knowledge in Python, Java, or Go.

Good problem-solving and communication skills.

Preferred Experience

Experience in FinTech, Banking, Crypto or Blockchain companies.

Knowledge of Crypto Wallet Security.

Certifications such as CEH, OSCP or CISSP are an added advantage.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resume with the KoinBX HR Team.

Pay: ₹83,333.00 - ₹125,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
